topic: Project schedule history — repeated postponements and a 2025 'abandonment' report ahead of the Aug 2026 restart plan
wiki_text: New Fortress Energy announced the $700mn Puerto Sandino gas-to-power project in 2020, amid Nicaragua's sociopolitical crisis; a first startup postponement followed in 2021 tied to US sanctions on Nicaraguan electricity-sector officials (though sector specialists attributed the delay to COVID-era gas-price volatility rather than the sanctions themselves). Start-of-operations slipped again in Nov 2024 (to 2025). By Oct 2025, MarketScreener/bne IntelliNews reported NFE 'appears to abandon' the project, noting Nicaragua had dropped out of NFE's detailed earnings-call disclosures (unlike Brazil and Puerto Rico) amid the company's broader financial strain (Nasdaq non-compliance notice, stock decline). As of Aug 2026, TradeWinds reports the project is back on a firm schedule, with commissioning of the (now stated) 3 mtpa terminal expected to start in October 2026 — see the staged LatestPlannedStartYear slip.
